'''Tom Sokol''' published constructed lists on Decipher Deck Designs.

* [[Tom Sokol Thank The Maker]] (LS, January 1998)

== 1997 World Championship statement ==

"I just turned 14 last week. Some hobbies include Star Wars CCG (duh.), Star Trek CCG (I just got into the game), Nintendo 64, watching The Simpsons, Star Trek and X-Files on TV. Some cool movies include Aliens, Terminator 2 and other good sci-fi's."<ref name="dec97bio">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/sokol.html Tom Sokol], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990428102106/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/sokol.html Internet Archive]</ref>
